hints.text: The door must always be closed at startup. Use the Point in direction __ command to set the position of the door.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text:
The door opens when you press the space bar.
The "Rotate clockwise __ degrees" command will rotate the door relative to itself. Let's put it inside a loop so that it does it multiple times.
hints.title: The door turns

presentation.text: Help the robots meet! Program the door to open when you press the space bar!
presentation.title: Open the door

hints.text: The knight starts moving from the lower-left corner and looks to the right.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text: To get around one side of the tower, the knight takes 10 steps 25 times.
hints.title: The knight walks around one side of the tower

hints.text: Each time after going around a wall, the knight turns 90 degrees. Note: counterclockwise turn.
hints.title: The knight turns

hints.text: To get around the 4 walls, the knight needs to repeat the walk and turn 4 times.
hints.title: Loop

presentation.text: The knight is on duty and guarding the tower! Program it to walk around the tower from all sides.
presentation.title: The knight

hints.text: At startup, the egg is at a certain point, turned in a certain direction, and not broken.
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text: If the position changes are instantaneous, we will not see the difference. Let's add a 1-second delay to see the animation.
hints.title: Delay

hints.text:
Use the "turn 90 degrees" command.
Note that the egg will turn to the left.
hints.title: The egg turns

hints.text:
To visually drop the egg on its side, but so that it doesn't move, you need to change the coordinate.
What coordinate should change if the egg moves to the left?
hints.title: The egg moves to the left

presentation.text: Crack the egg! To do that, program a 90° rotation.
presentation.title: Egg

hints.text:
The ball sprite must rotate around its axis.
Use the commands "repeat __ times", "turn ___".
hints.title: Repeating turns

hints.text: Think about how to change the rotation speed.
hints.title: *Bonus: change the speed

presentation.text: The ball sprite is spinning like a real one! Program it.
presentation.title: The ball is spinning!

hints.text: First, program the rotation of the butterfly — just like the ball in the previous task!
hints.title: Rotation

hints.text: To make a circle, add the command "move __ steps" to the loop. Then, after each small turn, the butterfly will move to the side, and then again make a turn and step: that is rotation!
hints.title: Circular movement

presentation.text: The butterfly flies around the flower. Program it!
presentation.title: Butterfly

tips.title: Sprite center
tips.description: Notice the small gray circle on the cloth of the sprite's costume. This is the center of the sprite around which it rotates.

hints.text: At startup, the time is exactly 12:00!
hints.title: Initial placement

hints.text:
Does the arrow move clockwise or counterclockwise?
The whole circle is 360 degrees. 60 seconds in one circle. 360 divided by 60 = 6.
The second hand rotates 6 degrees every second.
hints.title: Movement of the second hand

hints.text: Have you noticed that the minute hand moves less often and a shorter distance than the second hand? Let's move it one degree at a time. The minute hand moves 6 degrees in 60 seconds. 60 seconds divided by 6 degrees is 10 seconds — after that, the minute hand will move 1 degree.
hints.title: Movement of the minute hand

presentation.text: This clock will be just like a real one after you program it.
presentation.title: Clock
